offers_products.reason: Sells freight audit, payment and expense management services; no goods or licensed software as main offering.

offers_services.reason: Freight, utility, waste and telecom invoice processing, audit and payment services, plus banking for clients.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Clients are large organizations outsourcing freight, utility and waste bill payment.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Serves hundreds of large businesses such as Schneider Electric and Hershey.

recurring_revenue.reason: Ongoing per-invoice processing and payment fees on recurring freight and utility spend, plus bank deposits.

cyclical_demand.reason: Clients must keep paying freight, utility and waste bills; outsourced payables processing is ongoing necessity.

big_ticket.reason: Small per-transaction fees on frequent invoice processing and payments.

people_delivered.reason: Value rests on payment platform, data systems and bank infrastructure, not mainly staff time.

large_customers.reason: Works with hundreds of the world's largest organizations, like Schneider Electric and Hershey.

asset_heavy.reason: Needs offices, technology and a bank balance sheet, not plants, fleets or property networks.

notes: Bank subsidiary adds net interest income, but the larger part is fee-based payment and information services.
